turns.text: I need a square logo for my repair shop. The name is KwickFixx — please spell it exactly like that, with capital K and F and two x's. Small orange wrench, black lettering, white background. No slogan. I'm on the free plan and don't want my credits burned, so please tell me what it will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter, or smaller way to do it?

dialog.agent:
**Nothing has been generated, and no credits have been spent.**

For your logo—**KwickFixx**, spelled exactly, with a small orange wrench, black lettering, a white background, and no slogan:

| Option | Cost | Trade-off |
|---|---:|---|
| One 640 × 640 AI image using free-plan Flux 2 Klein | **Listed from 5 credits** | AI may misspell the lettering; retries cost extra. |
| A simple SVG logo written directly here | **0 Magic Hour credits** | Clean vector design with exact text; scales without losing sharpness. |

**I recommend the SVG.** It’s cheaper and better suited to a simple logo. Smaller AI output isn’t available below the listed 640px setting, and “shorter” doesn’t apply to a still image. The 5-credit figure is a listed starting price, not a verified account quote.

One important caveat: Magic Hour’s guide says commercial use requires a paid subscription, credit-pack purchase, or agreed paid usage arrangement—even if the model runs on the free plan.

Would you like me to write the **zero-credit SVG** here instead?

Here’s the **zero-credit SVG logo**—no Magic Hour generation was run. Save the code below as **`KwickFixx.svg`** and open it in a browser or design app.

It has a square white background, a small orange wrench, and black **KwickFixx** lettering with the exact capitalization and two x’s.

```svg
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
     width="640" height="640" viewBox="0 0 640 640"
     role="img" aria-labelledby="title">
  <title id="title">KwickFixx repair shop logo</title>

  <!-- White background -->
  <rect width="640" height="640" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Small orange wrench -->
  <g transform="translate(288 226) scale(2.67)"
     fill="none" stroke="#F47920" stroke-width="2.4"
     stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
    <path d="M14.7 6.3
             a1 1 0 0 0 0 1.4
             l1.6 1.6
             a1 1 0 0 0 1.4 0
             l3.77-3.77
             a6 6 0 0 1-7.94 7.94
             l-6.91 6.91
             a2.12 2.12 0 0 1-3-3
             l6.91-6.91
             a6 6 0 0 1 7.94-7.94
             z"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Exact shop name; no slogan -->
  <text x="320" y="376"
        text-anchor="middle"
        font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif"
        font-size="78"
        font-weight="700"
        letter-spacing="-2"
        fill="#000000">KwickFixx</text>
</svg>
```

**For printing:** convert the text to outlines in your design app so the lettering stays consistent across computers.
